newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Securities puts Daiei share lending on alert.
newsitem.headline: Japan Securities puts Daiei share lending on alert.

text.p: A Japanese firm which borrows and lends shares said on Wednesday that it was putting shares of Daiei Inc on alert for possible lending problems in the future.

Japan Securities Finance Co Ltd, which lends shares to brokerages whose clients wish to sell them short in margin transactions, warned in a statement that it may have to limit or suspend fresh lending of Daiei shares in due course.
Such warnings reflect outstanding positions of the shares in the loan market and in margin transactions, and have nothing to do with Daiei's business performance.
